biotools.summary: scTail is a computational method for detecting polyadenylation sites (PAS) using first-strand reads in 3' scRNA-seq data, enabling the quantification of alternative PAS usage. It can be combined with BRIE2 to discover differential alternative PAS usage in biological processes like cancer and development.
